sections.body: FICTION books are made-up stories, like a dragon who bakes cakes. 🐉
NON-FICTION books give real facts, like a book about how volcanoes work. 🌋
Non-fiction often has headings, photos, labels and a contents page.
Find one fiction and one non-fiction book at home or school. How can you tell?
Visit a library together and explore both sections. Non-fiction about a child's hobby is a great way into reading.

quiz.q: A book about real sharks and what they eat is…
hints: Is it real or made up?
A book called 'How Rain Forms' is real facts. What kind of book is that?
quiz.explain: It gives real facts, so it's non-fiction.

options: A talking teapot goes on an adventure
hints: 'A pig who flies a plane' is made up. Find another made-up one.
quiz.explain: Teapots can't talk, so it's a made-up story: fiction.
